people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
translations.bsb: Aware that His disciples were grumbling about this teaching, Jesus asked them, “Does this offend you?
translations.kjv: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
